label: Rated capacity
definition: The total number of ampere-hours that can be withdrawn from a fully charged battery under reference conditions

label: Certified usable battery energy
definition: The usable battery energy according to the procedure in the UN GTR No 22 as determined during the certification of the vehicle

label: Original power capability
definition: The amount of energy that a battery is capable to provide over a given period of time under reference conditions

label: Maximum permitted battery power
definition: The value of maximum permitted power the battery is rated for and reflects the data relevant for power limits

label: Ratio between nominal battery power and battery energy
definition: The suitable approximate value of the power capability used to designate or identify the battery, while the battery energy is determined in reference conditions to be defined

label: Initial round trip energy efficiency
definition: The ratio of the net energy delivered by a battery during a discharge test to the total energy required to restore the initial state of charge by a standard charge (see BattReg Annex IV (6))

label: Remaining capacity
definition: The corresponding in-use data attribute to rated capacity

label: Remaining usable battery energy
definition: The usable battery energy at the present point in the lifetime of a battery as determined according to the procedure in the UN GTR No 22

label: Capacity threshold for exhaustion
definition: The percentage of SOCE, above which the battery is still considered operational as EV battery in its current life, as provided by the economic operator

label: State of certified energy, SOCE
definition: The measured or on-board usable battery energy performance at a specific point in its lifetime, expressed as a percentage of the certified usable battery energy.

label: State of Charge, SoC
definition: The available energy or charge in a battery expressed as a percentage of rated capacity as declared by the manufacturer. When the battery’s state of health is no longer equal to its initial condition, SoC refers to the maximum energy or charge that can be stored in the battery at the time of charging.

label: Remaining power capability
definition: The amount of energy that a battery is capable to provide over a given period of time under reference conditions at a distinct point in time during its usage

label: Remaining round trip energy efficiency
definition: The in-use analogy to the initial roundtrip energy the ratio of the net energy delivered by a battery during a discharge test to the total energy required to restore the initial state of charge by a standard charge

label: Current self-discharge rate
definition: The change of the self-discharge rate in an idle state of the battery in reference conditions (temperature etc.) at aging parameter x, e.g. after a certain amount of storage time or, number of cycles

label: Temperature information
definition: Temperature information regarding operating environmental conditions

label: Number of full charging and discharging cycles
definition: In-use number of (full) charging and discharging cycles

label: Energy throughput
definition: The overall sum of the energy throughput over the battery lifetime at a specific time during usage

label: Capacity throughput
definition: The overall sum of the capacity throughput over the battery lifetime at a specific time during usage

label: Nominal voltage
definition: The suitable approximate value of the voltage used to designate or identify the battery

label: Minimum voltage
definition: The lower voltage limit that the safe operation of the battery is rated for

label: Maximum voltage
definition: The upper voltage limit that the safe operation of the battery is rated for

definition: The ratio of the net energy delivered by a battery during a discharge test to the total energy required to restore the initial state of charge by a standard charge (see BattReg Annex IV (6))

label: Initial self-discharge rate
definition: The self-discharge-rate in an idle state of the battery in reference conditions (temperature etc.) at begin of life

label: Evolution of self-discharge rates
definition: The change of self-discharge over time and usage, as percentage calculated from the initial and current self-discharge rate.

label: Initial internal resistance of battery cell
definition: "Quotient of change of voltage of a battery by the corresponding change in discharge current under specified conditions” (IEV 482 03 36)

label: Initial internal resistance of battery module
definition: "Quotient of change of voltage of a battery by the corresponding change in discharge current under specified conditions” (IEV 482 03 36)

label: Initial internal resistance of battery pack
definition: "Quotient of change of voltage of a battery by the corresponding change in discharge current under specified conditions” (IEV 482 03 36)

label: Internal resistance increase of battery cell

label: Internal resistance increase of battery module
definition: The increase over time and upon usage of internal resistance

label: Internal resistance increase of battery pack
definition: The increase over time and upon usage of internal resistance

label: Expected lifetime: Number of charge-discharge cycles
definition: Expected life-time under the reference conditions for which they have been designed in terms of cycles, except for non-cycle applications, and calendar years

label: Cycle-life reference test
definition: The reference test for “Expected lifetime: Number of charge-discharge cycles”

label: C-rate of relevant cycle-life test
definition: Measurement parameter for “Expected lifetime: Number of charge-discharge cycles”: Applied charge and discharge rate in terms of rated capacity (C-rate) of relevant cycle-life reference test

label: Capacity fade
definition: The decrease over time and upon usage in the amount of charge that a battery can deliver at the rated voltage, with respect to the original rated capacity as declared by the manufacturer

label: Power fade
definition: The decrease over time and upon usage in the amount of power that a battery can deliver at the rated voltage

label: Energy round trip efficiency fade
definition: The decrease of round trip energy efficiency as percentage

label: Temperature range idle state, upper boundary
definition: The upper boundary of the surrounding temperature range

label: Time spent in extreme temperatures above boundary
definition: The aggregated time, in which temperatures above the upper boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, upper boundary' are prevalent

label: Time spent in extreme temperatures below boundary
definition: The aggregated time, in which temperatures below the lower boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, lower boundary' are prevalent

label: Time spent charging during extreme temperatures above boundary
definition: The aggregated time, in which the battery is charged, while temperatures above the upper boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, upper boundary' are prevalent

label: Time spent charging during extreme temperatures below boundary
definition: The aggregated time, in which the battery is charged, while temperatures below the lower boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, lower boundary' are prevalent

label: Information on accidents

label: Number of deep discharge events
definition: The number of occasions, in which voltage has dropped below the lower operational limit as provided in the battery passport

label: Number of overcharge events
definition: The number of occasions, in which voltage has increased above the upper operational limit as provided in the battery passport
